title: The last Administrator cannot be left with zero users
custom_preconds: 1. The organization has exactly one user on the Administrator role.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as that sole Administrator.
  2. Go to Settings > Staff and open your own record.
  3. Try to change your role away from Administrator.
  4. Try to save.
custom_expected:
Saving is blocked (the organization must keep at least one Administrator).

If no such rule exists, raise it as a finding for the product team.
viu_status: Blocked-UI (needs live role editor / roles list)
evidence: Needs live UI; invariant to confirm.
